_about: The three blind lens readers' answers for the four options added on the 28 Nov re-run of Wednesday and Friday, as they replied; only each reply's lens label is set to the config id it was run under (series, funniest_true, most_absurd_true).

wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.text: A vocal plugin has a price that changes on a date: buy before the cut-off and you save $70 on a tool that now does a job singers used to pay a mix engineer for.
The plugin turns a vocal into words on screen, so a singer can find and treat a single sung word by reading it rather than by scrubbing through a waveform.
wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.rests_on: Open up Moments on a vocal recording and the plugin will transcribe the lyrics automatically in the edit window.

wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.text: The promise is a chain built for your voice, but it hears only part of the take, so whatever happens in the rest of the song is a guess based on that one section.
wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.rests_on: This AI-powered mixing tool listens to a portion of your vocal and designs a customized processing chain to match it.

wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.text: Generated worlds are billed by the second, like a taxi meter, so a full two-minute session costs about twelve dollars before anyone has made anything with it.
wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.rests_on: roughly $0.10 for every second of streamed output

wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.text: Picture and sound come out of the same model at the same moment, at film frame rate, so a game designer or video maker gets a world that already has its own soundtrack.
wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.rests_on: generating continuous 720p worlds at 24fps with synchronized native audio

wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.text: Sessions are sold at two minutes, but the picture can start to wobble after one, so you may be paying for the last minute of a world that is coming apart.
wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.rests_on: visual stability may degrade after 60 to 90 seconds

fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.text: Both the author and the publisher had written no-AI clauses, and the cover still got through, which shows that a clause on paper is a promise, not a check.
fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.rests_on: We have a no-AI clause in our contract. Tor also has a no-AI clause in their art contracts.

fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.text: The publisher blames its review step rather than the rule, so the weak point for illustrators is who looks at the art before it is printed, not what the contract says.
fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.rests_on: Tor takes full responsibility for the breakdown in our review process

fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.text: Cover artists sign contracts that ban generative AI, so when a cover with AI in it gets through, the money that should protect human illustration has bought a promise and nothing more.
fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.rests_on: policies and contracts with cover artists prohibiting generative AI

fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.text: The headline 84.4% is the real result, 42.2%, divided by 50, so it measures how close the avatar is to a coin toss, not how often it fools anyone.
fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.rests_on: 50% would mean they cannot tell at all, so Avatar 6 is 84.4% of the way there.

fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.text: Shown one clip at a time, raters judged about a fifth of genuine recordings fake, so real presenters do not pass this test every time either.
fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.rests_on: 65.1% of Avatar 6 clips judged real against 78.9% of real recordings

fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.text: The test puts the avatar right next to the real person, so the raters can compare the two, and even then they picked the copy as the real one in more than four tries out of ten.
fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.rests_on: Side by side with the real recording, raters pick Avatar 6 as the real one 42.2% of the time.

wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.text: A vocal plugin now types out the lyrics for you, which means the engineer may finally learn what the singer has been mumbling for the last six takes.
wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.rests_on: Open up Moments on a vocal recording and the plugin will transcribe the lyrics automatically in the edit window.

wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.text: The new Nectar listens to only part of your vocal and then builds a whole effects chain around it. That is still more listening than most demos get.
wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.rests_on: This AI-powered mixing tool listens to a portion of your vocal and designs a customized processing chain to match it.

wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.text: The tool that tunes your voice also has its own key change: $179 until 7 December, then up to $249.

wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.text: Google's Genie 4 sessions run for up to two minutes, but the picture may start to wobble after 60 to 90 seconds. So the last stretch of every world you pay for may be the bit where it falls apart.
wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.rests_on: visual stability may degrade after 60 to 90 seconds

wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.text: At about ten cents a second, a full two-minute world costs roughly $12. That is a cinema ticket for a film that may not hold together until the end.
wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.rests_on: roughly $0.10 for every second of streamed output

wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.text: Google built whole worlds at 24 frames a second, the old cinema frame rate, then rendered them at 720p.
wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.rests_on: generating continuous 720p worlds at 24fps with synchronized native audio

fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.text: The cover had to get past two separate no-AI clauses, one in the author's contract and one in the artist's, and it got past both.
fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.rests_on: We have a no-AI clause in our contract. Tor also has a no-AI clause in their art contracts.

fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.text: Tor's own policy banned generative AI on its covers, so the rule was already written down. Nobody checked the cover against it.
fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.rests_on: Tor takes full responsibility for the breakdown in our review process

fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.text: In HeyGen's own test, one in five real recordings was judged fake. The avatar is closing in on humans, and humans are not doing that well at looking human either.
fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.rests_on: one clip at a time, 65.1% of Avatar 6 clips judged real against 78.9% of real recordings

fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.text: Raters picked the avatar over the real person 42.2% of the time, and HeyGen's maths turns that into 84.4% of the way to fooling everyone. It counts as a fail in the test, but it doubles in the press release.
fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.rests_on: 50% would mean they cannot tell at all, so Avatar 6 is 84.4% of the way there.

fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.text: Side by side, people still picked the real person most of the time. The avatar's best result is losing to a human by a modest margin.
fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.rests_on: Side by side with the real recording, raters pick Avatar 6 as the real one 42.2% of the time.

wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.text: Before a vocal plugin changes a single note of your heartfelt chorus, it types up the lyrics for you, like a stenographer at the session.
wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.rests_on: Open up Moments on a vocal recording and the plugin will transcribe the lyrics automatically in the edit window.

wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.text: The mixing tool needs to hear only part of your vocal to decide how all of it should be processed. Engineers spend years building up that kind of confidence.
wed/076c5675-4aee-4ad0-b400-6b10188fdb59.rests_on: This AI-powered mixing tool listens to a portion of your vocal and designs a customized processing chain to match it.

wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.text: A Genie 4 world can run for 120 seconds, but the picture may start to break down after 60 to 90. That means the last half-minute you pay for can be the part where the world is coming apart.
wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.rests_on: visual stability may degrade after 60 to 90 seconds

wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.text: Google's generated worlds are charged by the second, like a parking meter, so a full two-minute world comes to about twelve dollars.
wed/5675e3e4-3420-45a2-bc45-9e9cbd5902ee.rests_on: roughly $0.10 for every second of streamed output

fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.text: The author had a no-AI clause in her contract and the publisher had one in its art contracts. That is two separate bans on the same thing, and the cover still came out with generative AI on it.
fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.rests_on: We have a no-AI clause in our contract. Tor also has a no-AI clause in their art contracts.

fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.text: The rule against AI covers was already written. The part that broke, by the publisher's own account, was the step meant to check that the rule was followed.
fri/b38a7a98-50b4-4608-bf8e-b99d8181ac7b.rests_on: Tor takes full responsibility for the breakdown in our review process

fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.text: When raters saw one clip at a time, they judged real recordings to be real only 78.9% of the time. About one genuine person in five was taken for a fake.
fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.rests_on: 65.1% of Avatar 6 clips judged real against 78.9% of real recordings

fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.text: HeyGen's figure of "84.4% of the way there" is simply 42.2% doubled. On that scale a perfect fake scores 50% and gets called 100%.
fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.rests_on: 50% would mean they cannot tell at all, so Avatar 6 is 84.4% of the way there.

fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.text: Set side by side with an avatar, the real person still wins the contest of being themselves, but only by about 16 points.
fri/46dd71d0-6787-4bda-bd6c-b0e2bc4abca2.rests_on: Side by side with the real recording, raters pick Avatar 6 as the real one 42.2% of the time.
